title: Add Archetype to games
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds [Archetype](https://github.com/xnet-admin-1/archetype-game) to games
- Archetype is a collaborative storytelling game for Android where 2-4 players take turns building stories together. It uses the Pollinations text API (nova-fast model) for AI-powered story sparks, char

Fixes #11262

gist.headline: Stories, now multiplayer
gist.blurb: Archetype joined the game shelf: pass a story between friends, let nova-fast toss in a spark, and see where the plot wanders. The garden has acquired a tiny writers’ room.
gist.summary: Added Archetype to the games catalog, an Android collaborative storytelling game for 2–4 players that uses the Pollinations text API with nova-fast for AI-generated story sparks.
gist.impact: Players can now discover an Android game where a small group builds stories turn by turn with nova-fast prompts to keep the narrative moving.
gist.visual_concept: Depict a cozy shared storytelling table: Polli and three friendly pixel players gather around an Android tablet showing branching story pages, while glowing lime-green text-spark fireflies emerge from a code-plant. Polli wears a tiny writer’s beret and helps pass a scroll between the group, making the collaborative turn-taking visible.
